definition.name: Planning & Zoning Management
definition.overview:
A **Planning & Zoning Management** application is a local government's land-use regulatory system of record. It maintains the jurisdiction's zoning framework as it attaches to specific parcels of land, processes applications in which people request permission to use or develop land, moves each application through staff and agency review and a formal public decision, and records the resulting determinations — including any conditions of approval — against the property.

Its purpose is to make land-use regulation operable: without such a system, a planning department holds a zoning map and ordinance but has no way to consistently receive proposals, route them for review, notify affected neighbors, bring them before the empowered decision body, and keep an enforceable record of what was decided and under what conditions.

The boundary is regulatory and land-anchored. This is not the system that issues building permits for construction code compliance (Permit Management), not the system that reacts to violations (Code Enforcement Management), not the parcel ownership registry (Land Records), and not the map infrastructure itself (Government GIS) — although in practice these live close together and are frequently bundled.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**规划与分区管理**应用程序是地方政府的土地使用监管记录系统。它维护管辖区域的分区框架，该框架附着于特定的土地地块，处理人们请求使用或开发土地的申请，将每个申请通过工作人员和机构审查以及正式的公众决策，并记录由此产生的决定——包括任何批准条件——针对该财产。

其目的是使土地使用监管可操作：没有这样的系统，规划部门持有分区地图和条例，但没有办法持续接收提案、路由它们以供审查、通知受影响的邻居、将它们提交给有权决策的主体，并保持可执行的记录，记录决定了什么以及在什么条件下。

边界是监管性的和以土地为锚的。这不是为建筑规范合规性颁发建筑许可证的系统（许可证管理），不是对违规行为做出反应的系统（代码执行管理），不是地块所有权登记册（土地记录），也不是地图基础设施本身（政府GIS）——尽管在实践中这些系统经常紧密联系并经常捆绑在一起。
definition.dc:
```text
Zoning framework of record
└── attached to parcels of land
    └── Land-use application (typed case on a specific parcel)
        └── Review & circulation → Public notice & hearing
            └── Recorded decision (+ conditions)
                └── Property's land-use record
```
definition.dc_zh:
记录分区框架
└── 附加到土地地块
    └── 土地使用申请（特定地块上的分类案例）
        └── 审查与流转 → 公告与听证
            └── 记录的决定（+条件）
                └── 财产的土地使用记录
definition.rules:
- **Decision authority is structured.** Some application types are decided administratively by staff; others must go to the planning commission, zoning board, or council, sometimes with a required public hearing. The application type drives which path is mandatory.
- **Public notice is a legal obligation, not a courtesy.** For designated case types the jurisdiction must notify affected property owners and publish the hearing. The system's radius-based owner lookup and templated notices exist to satisfy this.
- **Conditions gate closure.** Where conditions of approval are used, the case file commonly cannot be closed until each condition is cleared and signed off — ensuring approvals are actually implemented, not just granted.
- **Decisions attach to the land.** Outcomes and conditions become part of the property's record and are visible to other departments; a condition imposed in a planning case constrains what building and enforcement staff will later accept on that property.
- **The case record is durable.** Cases persist from intake through archival; the archive is the jurisdiction's memory of what was permitted, denied, and conditioned on each parcel.
- **Deadlines are tracked.** Jurisdictions commonly work under statutory or self-imposed processing-time targets; products surface per-case urgency against these targets.
- **Cross-department visibility shapes behavior.** Because violations, permits, and planning conditions share the property record, staff can see — before approving — what else is pending or in violation on the same land.
definition.rules_zh:
- **决策权是结构化的。** 一些申请类型由工作人员行政决定；其他必须提交给规划委员会、分区委员会或议会，有时需要公开听证。申请类型驱动哪条路径是强制性的。
- **公开公告是法律义务，而不是礼节。** 对于指定的案例类型，管辖区域必须通知受影响的财产所有者并发布听证。系统的基于半径的所有者查找和模板化公告是为了满足这一要求。
- **条件限制关闭。** 在使用批准条件的地方，案例文件通常不能关闭，直到每个条件都被清除并签署——确保批准被实际实施，而不仅仅是授予。
- **决定附着于土地。** 结果和条件成为财产记录的一部分，并对其他部门可见；在规划案例中施加的条件限制了建筑和执法人员后来在该财产上接受的内容。
- **案例记录是持久的。** 案例从受理到存档持续存在；存档是管辖区域对每个地块允许、拒绝和条件的记忆。
- **截止日期被跟踪。** 管辖区域通常在法定或自设的处理时间目标下工作；产品显示每个案例相对于这些目标的紧迫性。
- **跨部门可见性塑造行为。** 因为违规、许可证和规划条件共享财产记录，工作人员可以在批准前看到同一土地上还有什么待处理或违规。

definition.name: Property Assessment System
definition.overview:
A **Property Assessment System** is a government's system of record for property value. It maintains a persistent record of every property in the jurisdiction — its characteristics and its owners or interest holders — values the entire property population systematically rather than one property at a time, and produces the **assessment roll**: the official, dated, per-parcel statement of value from which property taxes are ultimately calculated.

The defining structure is deliberately small:

```text
Parcel / assessment account (identified property of record)
└── Mass appraisal valuation machinery
    (standardized approaches to value, calibrated against market data,
     producing a value for every parcel as of a valuation date)
    └── The assessment roll of record
        (official per-parcel values → taxable value, published, noticed,
         changed only through governed processes: appeals, corrections, abatements)
```

Remove the parcel record and there is nothing to value and no one to notify. Remove the mass-appraisal machinery and the office is back to producing one-off appraisals. Remove the roll and the system is a valuation calculator with no official deliverable — the "assessment" in the Type's name disappears.

Everything else commonly associated with these products — sketching, field data collection, GIS integration, public lookup portals, personal property, state reporting, appeals case management — is widespread standard capability or variant machinery, not part of the definition. The professional distinction underneath the software is worth stating plainly: the assessing office determines **value**; it does not set tax rates or collect taxes. The assessed valuation determines each property's share of the tax burden; billing and collection are downstream operations with their own systems.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**财产评估系统**是政府记录财产价值的官方系统。它维护着辖区内每一处财产的持久记录——其特征和所有者或权益持有人——系统地评估整个财产群体的价值，而不是一次评估一处财产，并产生**评估册**：官方、按日期、按地块的价值声明，财产税最终据此计算。

其定义结构被刻意设计得简洁：

```text
地块/评估账户（已识别的记录财产）
└── 批量评估估值机制
    （标准化的价值方法，针对市场数据进行校准，
     为每个地块在估值日期产生一个价值）
    └── 记录的评估册
        （官方按地块的价值 → 应税价值，已发布，已通知，
         仅通过受控流程更改：申诉、更正、减免）
```

移除地块记录，就没有东西可评估，也没有人可通知。移除批量评估机制，办公室就回到产生一次性评估的状态。移除评估册，系统就是一个没有官方交付物的估值计算器——类型名称中的“评估”就消失了。

这些产品通常关联的其他所有功能——草图绘制、现场数据收集、GIS集成、公共查询门户、个人财产、州报告、申诉案例管理——都是广泛的标准能力或变体机制，并非定义的一部分。软件背后的专业区分值得明确说明：评估办公室确定**价值**；它不设定税率或征收税款。评估价值确定了每处财产的税收份额；账单和征收是下游操作，有自己的系统。
definition.dc:
**Parcel / assessment account.** The individually identified property record — the unit to which everything attaches: land attributes, building characteristics, sketches and photos, the parties holding interests (owners, and in some jurisdictions other interest classes), and the value history across years. The parcel persists across ownership changes; a transfer changes who holds it, not that it exists. Jurisdictions subdivide and combine parcels, and mature products keep the resulting genealogy. Many systems track the parcel year by year, so the record is effectively a versioned history rather than a single current snapshot. Some jurisdictions also assess a second class — personal property (business assets) — either as separate accounts or in the same database.

**Mass appraisal valuation machinery.** The systematic valuation of the whole property population under standardized approaches to value. The recognized approaches are the **cost approach** (replacement cost of improvements adjusted for depreciation, drawing on published cost manuals or jurisdiction-specific cost tables), the **market / sales-comparison approach** (values derived from comparable sales), and the **income approach** (income and expense streams capitalized into value, used mainly for commercial and industrial property). Models are calibrated against market data — recorded sales, ratio studies, statistical analysis — and applied in mass: every parcel in scope receives a value as of a defined **valuation date**. Individual appraiser judgment still operates, but on top of the mass run — reviewing, adjusting, and verifying — not instead of it.

**The assessment roll of record.** The authoritative deliverable: the dated, per-parcel list of determined values, together with the rule-driven adjustments — exemptions, classification, and similar machinery — that derive each parcel's **taxable value**. The roll is what the jurisdiction publishes, what assessment notices are generated from, what taxpayers appeal against, and what the tax-billing operation consumes. It is an official artifact: once certified, it is not silently edited. Later changes arrive as governed corrections, abatements, or appeal decisions, each leaving a trace in the value history.
definition.dc_zh:
**地块/评估账户。** 即独立标识的房产记录——所有信息依附于此单元：土地属性、建筑物特征、图纸与照片、权益持有方（所有者，在部分辖区还包括其他权益类别），以及跨年度的价值历史。地块在产权变更中持续存在；转让改变的是持有者而非其存在本身。辖区会对地块进行细分与合并，成熟的产品会保留由此形成的谱系关系。许多系统按年跟踪地块，因此记录实际上是经过版本管理的历史，而非单一的当前快照。部分辖区还会评估第二类——个人财产（商业资产），这些可能作为独立账户存在，也可能在同一数据库中。

**批量评估估值机制。** 即在标准化价值方法下，对整体房产群体进行系统性估值。公认的方法包括**成本法**（基于改善重置成本并考虑折旧，参考公开成本手册或辖区特定成本表）、**市场/销售比较法**（通过可比销售得出价值）以及**收益法**（将收入与支出流资本化为价值，主要用于商业地产和工业地产）。模型需根据市场数据校准——包括已记录的销售、比率研究、统计分析。
definition.rules:
### Values are as-of a valuation date

Every value belongs to a dated valuation context. The roll is a dated artifact, not a live price; "current" values are the ones certified for the current cycle. Mature products keep versioned, year-by-year value histories precisely because of this.

### The assessor values; the assessor does not tax

The assessing operation determines the value that determines each property's share of the tax burden; it does not set rates, bill, or collect. This division is the structural seam to the tax-administration system, which consumes the certified roll.

### The certified roll changes only through governed processes

After certification, values are not edited in place. Corrections, abatements, and appeal decisions are recorded as discrete, traceable events that produce revised values while preserving history. This is what makes the roll an official record rather than a spreadsheet.

### Appeals are the taxpayer's lever — and bounded

Taxpayers may contest values, but within the jurisdiction's appeal structure: defined windows, defined boards or review bodies, evidence requirements. Products differ in how much of this process they automate — from visibility-only support for external boards to full end-to-end case management — but the write-back of decisions into values is the constant.

### Equity is measured, not assumed

Assessment quality is monitored statistically: sales ratio studies and related measures show whether values track the market and whether similar properties carry similar values. This measurement loop is a standard part of the discipline and is built into mature products' analytical tooling.

### The parcel persists; ownership moves

A sale does not create a new parcel — it re-binds the existing one. Splits and combinations do create and retire parcels, and the genealogy of those events is kept. Assessment liability follows the interest holders as recorded at the relevant time.

### Upstream and downstream dependencies

Ownership and sales data typically flow in from the land-records side; parcel geometry flows in from GIS; permits and inspections feed characteristic updates. Downstream, the certified roll flows to tax billing and statutory reports flow to oversight bodies. The assessment system is a hub on the parcel spine, but it originates none of those neighboring records.
definition.rules_zh:
### 价值基于估值日期

每个价值都属于一个有日期的估值上下文。评估册是一个有日期的产物，而不是实时价格；“当前”价值是当前周期认证的那些。成熟产品保留版本化、逐年价值历史，正是因为如此。

### 评估师估值；评估师不征税

评估操作确定了确定每处财产税收份额的价值；它不设定税率、开单或征收。这种分工是与税收管理系统的结构性接缝，后者使用认证的评估册。

### 认证评估册仅通过受控流程更改

认证后，价值不会被就地编辑。更正、减免和申诉决定被记录为离散、可追溯的事件，在保留历史的同时产生修订价值。这就是使评估册成为官方记录而非电子表格的原因。

### 申诉是纳税人的杠杆——但有限制

纳税人可以对价值提出异议，但在辖区的申诉结构内：定义的窗口、定义的委员会或审查机构、证据要求。产品在自动化这个过程的程度上不同——从对外部委员会的可见性支持到完整的端到端案例管理——但将决定写回价值是恒定的。

### 公平性是衡量的，不是假设的

评估质量通过统计监控：销售比率研究和相关措施显示价值是否跟踪市场，以及类似财产是否具有类似价值。这个衡量循环是该学科的标准部分，并内置于成熟产品的分析工具中。

### 地块持久；所有权移动

一次销售不会创建新地块——它重新绑定现有地块。分割和合并。

definition.name: Property Tax Administration
definition.overview:
A **Property Tax Administration** system is a government's system of record for property tax money. It receives certified taxable values from the assessment side, applies the jurisdiction's levies to produce each property's tax bill, records payments against those bills across every collection channel, pursues delinquent balances under statutory charges, and settles the collected money to the taxing entities entitled to it.

The defining structure is deliberately small:

```text
Certified taxable values (from the assessment side)
└── Levy-driven billing
    (taxing entities + rates/levies applied per property → the tax bill)
    └── The tax bill/account of record
        (liability per property × tax year: amount due, payments,
         penalties and interest, status)
        └── Collection & settlement loop
            (payments by every channel → delinquency machinery →
             distribution to the taxing entities)
```

Remove the bill and there is no liability to collect. Remove the levy machinery and the product is generic invoicing. Remove collection and settlement and it is a bill printer.

The professional division underneath the software is worth stating plainly: the assessing office determines **value**; the levying bodies — county, municipality, school district, special districts — set **rates and levies**; the tax administration office **applies both**. It computes, bills, collects, and distributes. It originates neither the value nor the rate. Everything commonly bundled with these products — cashiering hardware, taxpayer portals, escrow-agent portals, business and tourist taxes, business intelligence — is standard capability or variant machinery, not part of what makes the product what it is.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**财产税管理**系统是政府用于记录财产税收入的官方系统。它接收来自评估部门的认证应税价值，应用管辖区的税款征收来生成每个物业的税单，记录通过各个征收渠道对这些税单的支付情况，依据法定费用追讨逾期欠款，并将征收的资金结算给有权获得这些资金的征税实体。

其定义性的结构被刻意设计得简单明了：

```text
认证应税价值（来自评估部门）
└── 征收驱动的开票
    （征税实体 + 针对每个物业应用的税率/征收 → 税单）
    └── 税单/官方记录账目
        （每个物业的负债 × 纳税年度：应缴金额、支付记录、
         罚款与利息、状态）
        └── 征收与结算循环
            （通过所有渠道的支付 → 逾期处理机制 → 
             分配给征税实体）
```

移除税单，则没有可征收的负债。移除征收机制，该产品就变成通用的开票软件。移除征收与结算功能，它就只是一个税单打印机。

软件背后的专业分工值得清晰说明：评估办公室确定**价值**；征税机构——县、市、学区、特别区——设定**税率和征收项目**；税务管理办公室则**应用这两者**。它负责计算、开票、征收和分配。它既不创设价值，也不设定税率。通常与这些产品捆绑在一起的所有其他功能——出纳硬件、纳税人门户、托管代理门户、商业与旅游税、商业智能——都是标准能力或变体机制，并非定义该产品本质的部分。
definition.dc:
**The tax bill/account of record.** The individually identified liability record — one property (or taxpayer account) for one tax period — carrying the amount due, the payments and credits applied, the statutory charges (interest, penalties, fees), and the current status. It is the object every workflow touches: bills are produced from it, payments post to it, delinquency is computed from it, corrections amend it, and settlement draws on it. Mature systems keep the full history per account — payments to date, corrected bills, notes and documents — because the record is the office's official account of who owes what.

**Levy-driven billing against taxable values.** The jurisdiction's taxing entities and their rates or levies are maintained in the system and associated with properties. A single property commonly sits inside several taxing bodies at once — county, city, school district, special districts — and one tax bill aggregates all of their levies. The calculation applies these levies to the **taxable values** received from the assessment side, together with billing-time adjustments the jurisdiction provides (deductions, credits, exemptions applied at billing, special assessments). This levy machinery is the Type's specificity: it is what makes the output a property tax bill rather than an invoice.

**The collection-and-settlement loop.** Payments arrive through every channel the office offers — over the counter, by mail, in bulk files from banks and escrow agents, and online — and are recorded against the bills. Balances that remain unpaid past the statutory date become delinquent and accrue further charges; the office notices, pursues, and (where the regime provides) enforces through tax lien or tax deed processes. Collected money is not the office's to keep: it is distributed and settled to the entitled taxing entities according to their shares, with settlement reporting. This loop — collect the money, then settle it out — is what makes the system a revenue administration rather than a payment page.
definition.dc_zh:
税务账单/记录账户。个体识别的负债记录——一个物业（或纳税人账户）对应一个纳税期——包含应付款项、已应用的付款和信用、法定收费（利息、罚款、费用）以及当前状态。它是每个工作流接触的对象：账单从中生成，付款记录到其中，逾期从中计算，更正修改它，结算从中提取。成熟的系统保留每个账户的完整历史——迄今为止的付款、更正的账单、笔记和文件——因为记录是办公室关于谁欠什么的官方账户。

基于征税的账单对 taxable values。管辖区内的征税实体及其税率或征收费率维护在系统中并与物业关联。一个物业通常同时属于多个征税机构——县、市、学区、特别区——一个税单汇总了所有这些征收费率。计算将这些征收费率应用于从评估方收到的应税价值，加上管辖区提供的账单时调整（扣除、信用、账单时应用的豁免、特别评估）。这种征税机制是该类型的特异性：它使输出成为房产税账单而非发票。

征收和结算循环。付款通过每个渠道到达...
definition.rules:
### The office applies value × levy; it sets neither

The taxable value comes from the assessment side; the rates and levies come from the levying bodies. The tax administration office's calculation is the application of both. This division is the structural seam to the assessment system, which produces the certified values the billing engine consumes.

### One bill, many taxing entities — and the money flows back

A bill aggregates the levies of several taxing bodies for the same property. Collected money is therefore apportioned back to those entities according to their shares, with settlement reporting. The system is the settlement authority between taxpayers and taxing entities, not merely a payment collector.

### Delinquency accrues by statute; enforcement is regime-dependent

Unpaid balances accrue interest, penalties, and fees on the jurisdiction's schedule, and notices follow. What happens next varies by regime: some jurisdictions sell tax lien certificates to investors, some sell tax-defaulted property deeds, some pursue other remedies. The delinquency machinery is universal; the enforcement endpoint is not.

### Corrections are governed events

After billing, amounts change only through named processes — court orders, additions, abatements, supplements, refunds, protested payments — each producing corrected bills while preserving the audit trail. This is what makes the account an official record rather than a spreadsheet.

### Duplicate payments and refunds are a named problem

Bulk escrow flows mean multiple parties may pay the same bill. Mature products explicitly prevent duplicate escrow payments and streamline refunds; a reduction in refunds and duplicate payments is a documented outcome offices buy these tools for.

### Bankruptcy and litigation constrain collection

Filings open cases that restrict or redirect collection activity; mature products carry bankruptcy/litigation case handling beside the delinquency machinery.

### Money is settled, not just received

Distribution — check runs, ACH transfers, settlement and disbursement reporting by entity, district, and year — is part of the loop, reconciled with the office's financial system.
definition.rules_zh:
### 办公室应用价值 × 征收；它既不设定价值也不设定征收

应税价值来自评估部门；税率和征收来自征税机构。税务管理办公室的计算是应用这两者。这种分工是与评估系统之间的结构性接缝，评估系统生产了开票引擎所消耗的认证价值。

### 一张税单，多个征税实体 —— 资金回流

一张税单汇总了多个征税机构对同一物业的征收。因此，征收的资金根据其份额被分配回这些实体，并附有结算报告。该系统是纳税人和征税实体之间的结算机构，而不仅仅是收款工具。

### 逾期根据法定规定累积；强制执行取决于法律制度

未付余额根据管辖区的日程累积利息、罚款和费用，并随之发出通知。接下来会发生什么因法律制度而异：一些管辖区向投资者出售税收留置权证书，一些出售税款拖欠物业契据，一些则寻求其他补救措施。逾期处理机制是普遍的；但强制执行的终点则不是。

### 更正是受控事件

开票后，金额只能通过指定程序变更——法院命令、追加、减免、补充、有争议的支付——每个程序都会生成更正税单，同时保留审计线索。这就是为什么该账目是官方记录，而不仅仅是一个电子表格。

### 重复支付和退款是一个明确的问题

批量托管付款流意味着多方可能为同一张税单付款。成熟产品明确防止重复的托管付款并简化退款流程；减少退款和重复支付是办公室购买这些工具的一个有据可查的成果。

definition.name: Public Asset Management
definition.overview:
A **Public Asset Management** application is a public agency's system of record for the physical infrastructure estate it stewards — the roads, bridges, sidewalks, traffic signals, streetlights, signs, trees, parks and grounds assets, storm and waste lines, public buildings, and vehicles that make up a community's built environment.

It solves a specific stewardship problem: a public agency owns thousands of long-lived physical assets, funded by constrained public money, expected to deliver a safe and reliable level of service, and answerable to councils, oversight bodies, and residents for every dollar spent. The application gives the agency one durable register of what it owns and where, attaches every inspection and maintenance action to the asset it was performed on, and rolls condition, cost, and risk up into defensible decisions — what to fix, what to replace, what to defer, and how to justify those choices to the people funding them.

The defining core is small, and it is shared with the broader asset-management family:

```text
Public asset register of record
└── Recorded care attached to each asset
    │   (inspections/condition + work orders → persistent per-asset history)
    └── Lifecycle outlook feeding stewardship decisions
        (condition/cost/risk → repair-vs-replace → multi-year plans → funding justification)
```

held by a **public-steward operator**: an agency managing the estate in trust for public service, where the records exist to make stewardship defensible rather than to generate profit. What distinguishes this Type from generic enterprise asset management is that estate and that frame, not any single feature.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**公共资产管理**应用程序是公共机构用于管理其负责的实体基础设施资产的记录系统——包括道路、桥梁、人行道、交通信号灯、路灯、标志、树木、公园和场地资产、雨水和废物管线、公共建筑以及构成社区建成环境的车辆。

它解决了一个具体的管理问题：一个公共机构拥有数千个长期使用的实体资产，由受限的公共资金资助，期望提供安全可靠的服务水平，并对理事会、监督机构和居民负责每一笔支出。该应用程序为机构提供了一个持久的注册表，记录其拥有的资产及其位置，将每一次检查和维护操作与执行该操作的资产关联起来，并将状态、成本和风险汇总为可辩护的决策——修理什么、替换什么、推迟什么，以及如何向资助者证明这些选择的合理性。

定义核心很小，并且与更广泛的资产管理家族共享：

```text
公共资产注册记录
└── 附加到每个资产的记录维护
    │   （检查/状态 + 工单 → 持久化的每资产历史）
    └── 生命周期展望为管理决策提供信息
        （状态/成本/风险 → 修理 vs. 替换 → 多年计划 → 资金证明）
```

由**公共管理运营者**持有：一个机构以信托方式管理资产以提供公共服务，记录的存在是为了使管理可辩护，而不是为了盈利。使这种类型区别于通用企业资产管理的是那个资产和框架，而不是任何单一功能。
definition.dc:
- a work-order engine covering reactive and planned/preventive maintenance, with scheduling, assignment, and completion recording
- inspection programs with schedules, checklists, and condition scoring
- service-request intake (staff and, commonly, resident portals) converting into asset-bound work
- mobile field execution with offline support, photos, and location awareness
- contractor management — contracted work brought into the same system and schedule view
- per-asset cost rollup (labor, parts, vendor/contractor spend)
- map-based display of assets, work, and requests
- dashboards, KPIs, and risk scoring
- capital/renewal planning views: spend against budget, funding sources, project approval tracking
- configurable asset templates, hierarchies, and attribute sets
definition.dc_zh:
覆盖响应式和计划性/预防性维护的工作订单引擎，具备调度、分配和完成记录功能；
检查计划，包括日程安排、检查表和状态评分；
服务请求接收（员工和通常的居民门户），转换为与资产相关的工作；
移动现场执行，支持离线功能、照片上传和位置感知；
承包商管理——将承包工作纳入同一系统和日程视图；
逐资产成本汇总（人工、零件、供应商/承包商支出）；
基于地图的资产、工作和请求显示；
仪表板、关键绩效指标和风险评分；
资本/更新规划视图：预算支出、资金来源、项目审批跟踪；
可配置的资产模板、层次结构和属性集。
definition.rules:
- **The asset record is the anchor.** Inspections, work orders, costs, and requests bind to assets; the register's integrity is what makes history, condition, and planning coherent. Implementation guidance from vendors consistently frames registry quality as the precondition for reliable reporting and planning.
- **Care history accumulates and is never discarded.** The per-asset record of what was done, when, at what cost is the basis for troubleshooting, warranty and audit questions, and repair-vs-replace judgment.
- **Condition drives priority.** Maintenance and renewal priorities are derived from condition, risk, and service-level objectives — not from first-in-first-out queuing. Risk framing (likelihood × consequence) is a common realization.
- **Funding is the binding constraint.** Plans are built against available budgets and funding sources; scenario comparison exists precisely because the agency cannot afford everything the estate needs.
- **Requests become asset-bound work.** A resident report is not a free-floating ticket; it attaches to the asset in question and joins the same care pipeline as internally generated work.
- **Location is structural.** Work is scheduled and allocated against where assets are; spatial display reduces the effort of day-to-day work. The GIS realization varies (embedded, native, integrated), but the located-asset character does not.
- **Evidence is an output, not a byproduct.** Reports showing the reasoning behind decisions and the impact of investment are a first-class product of the system, consumed by councils, oversight bodies, and the public.
definition.rules_zh:
- **资产记录是锚点。** 检查、工单、成本和请求绑定到资产；注册表的完整性使历史、状态和规划保持连贯。供应商的实施指南始终将注册表质量作为可靠报告和规划的前提条件。
- **维护历史累积且永不丢弃。** 每资产记录（何时、以什么成本做了什么）是故障排除、保修和审计问题以及修理 vs. 判断的基础。
- **状态驱动优先级。** 维护和更新优先级源自状态、风险和服务水平目标——而不是先进先出排队。风险框架（可能性 × 后果）是一种常见实现。
- **资金是约束条件。** 计划根据可用预算和资金来源制定；场景比较的存在正是因为机构无法负担资产所需的一切。
- **请求变成资产绑定的工作。** 居民报告不是一个自由浮动的工单；它附加到相关资产，并加入与内部生成工作相同的维护流程。
- **位置是结构性的。** 工作根据资产位置进行调度和分配；空间显示减少日常工作量。GIS 实现各不相同（嵌入式、原生、集成），但定位资产特征不变。
- **证据是输出，不是副产品。** 展示决策推理和投资影响的报告是系统的一流产品，供理事会、监督机构和公众使用。

definition.name: Public Works Management
definition.overview:
A **Public Works Management** application is a public-works department's operational system for its service delivery: it receives and triages requests for service from the public and staff, turns them into crew-executed work orders, and records that work — with its labor, equipment, materials, and costs — against the public estate the department maintains.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Service request (recorded, located demand for service)
  ↓ triage / convert
Crew work order (assigned, scheduled, executed, closed with costs)
  ↓ attached to
Maintained public estate (streets, signs, lights, storm drains,
grounds, facilities, fleet — the department's domains of work)
  ↓ reported as
Service performance and cost visible to the public and the budget process
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — GIS mapping, citizen self-service portals, capital-planning analytics, FEMA cost reporting, seasonal snow programs — is widespread in current products or standard in certain regions, but is not what makes the application what it is. A department running the loop above on paper or on a 1990s work-order system was still doing public works management.

When the center shifts to the estate's own stewardship record (condition, renewal outlook, long-term plans), the product is drifting toward Public Asset Management. When it stays at the intake venue with a complaint lifecycle and no work execution, it is a citizen-request (311) platform.
definition.overview_zh:
一个 **公共工程管理** 应用程序是公共工程部门的服务交付运营系统：它接收并分类来自公众和员工的服务请求，将其转化为由团队执行的工作订单，并将该工作——连同其劳动力、设备、材料和成本——记录在部门维护的公共资产上。

其核心结构很简单：

```text
服务请求（记录、定位的服务需求）
  ↓ 分类 / 转化
团队工作订单（分配、调度、执行、关闭并记录成本）
  ↓ 附属于
维护的公共资产（街道、标志、路灯、排水沟、场地、设施、车队——部门的工作领域）
  ↓ 报告为
对公众和预算流程可见的服务绩效与成本
```

其他通常与这些产品相关的功能——GIS 地图、公民自助服务门户、资本规划分析、FEMA 成本报告、季节性雪天计划——在当前产品中普遍存在或在某些地区是标准配置，但并非定义该应用程序的核心要素。一个部门在纸上或 1990 年代的工作订单系统中运行上述循环，仍然在执行公共工程管理。

当重心转向资产自身的管理记录（状况、更新展望、长期计划）时，产品逐渐偏向公共资产管理。当重心停留在投诉受理环节，只有投诉生命周期而无工作执行时，它就是公民请求（311）平台。
definition.dc:
- asset/inventory records for the estate (location, class, condition, accumulated history), often visualized on a map
- a citizen request portal with notifications and live status; staff-side intake for phone and walk-in reports
- automatic assignment notifications (email/text) and personal "my assigned work" views
- planned and preventive maintenance schedules alongside demand-driven work
- inspections and checklists tied to assets or work orders
- cost accounting per work order and per asset, with exportable and scheduled reports
- a mobile field app: assigned work list, location and navigation, photos, completion, barcode/QR asset lookup
- dashboards for open/in-progress/completed work, backlog aging, and the reactive-versus-planned mix
- parts and supply inventory feeding work orders; document and photo attachments

Capabilities that depend on segment, region, or product line — capital-planning and predictive analytics, disaster cost-recovery reporting, community event bookings, utility-domain modules, sensor-triggered work — are covered under Variants.
definition.dc_zh:
- 资产/库存记录，针对不动产（位置、类别、状态、累积历史），常在地图上可视化
- 公民请求门户，带有通知和实时状态；工作人员端处理电话和现场报告
- 自动分配通知（电子邮件/短信）和个人“我的分配工作”视图
- 计划和预防性维护调度，以及需求驱动的工作
- 与资产或工单关联的检查和检查清单
- 按工单和资产进行成本核算，带有可导出和计划报告
- 移动现场应用：分配工作列表、位置和导航、照片、完成、条形码/二维码资产查找
- 仪表板，用于开放/进行中/完成的工作、积压老化以及反应性与计划性混合
- 零件和供应库存供应工单；文档和照片附件
definition.rules:
- **A request is not work.** Nothing happens to the estate until a request is triaged and converted into a work order; conversely, planned work enters without any request.
- **Assignment gates execution.** Work orders sit in an unassigned queue until a crew or worker owns them; notifications and personal dashboards make ownership explicit.
- **Completion carries cost.** A work order closed without its labor/equipment/material record is incomplete for the department's reporting purposes; the cost record is what turns work into accountability data.
- **Work accrues to objects.** Completed work attaches to the asset or location, so each object carries its own history — the basis for condition judgments, repeat-failure spotting, and future planning.
- **Requester visibility is a commitment.** Status flows back to the resident who reported the issue; response-time performance is part of the department's public standing.
- **Location discipline.** Requests and work orders are locatable (address, pin, coordinates, or asset reference) — unmapped work is the exception, not the rule.
- **Domain routing.** The department's domains (streets, fleet, facilities, grounds, utilities where applicable) route work to the right crews; one system spans them.
definition.rules_zh:
- **请求不等于工作。** 在请求被分类并转化为工作订单之前，资产上不会发生任何事情；相反，计划工作无需任何请求即可进入。
- **分配决定执行。** 工作订单停留在未分配队列中，直到团队或员工认领它们；通知和个人仪表板使所有权明确。
- **完成带来成本。** 一个没有劳动力/设备/材料记录的工作订单对于部门的报告目的来说是不完整的；成本记录是将工作转化为问责数据的关键。
- **工作归属于对象。** 完成的工作附加到资产或地点上，因此每个对象都承载自己的历史——这是状况判断、重复故障发现和未来规划的基础。
- **请求者可见性是一种承诺。** 状态反馈给报告问题的居民；响应时间绩效是部门公众形象的一部分。
- **位置规范。** 请求和工作订单必须可定位（地址、坐标点、坐标或资产引用）——未映射的工作是例外，而非规则。
- **领域路由。** 部门的领域（街道、车队、设施、场地、适用的公用事业）将工作路由到正确的团队；一个系统覆盖所有这些领域。
